confidence_levels.high: encoding and operation established by independent checks
confidence_levels.medium: statistically established or a single confirmed example; a sign or width may still be open
confidence_levels.format-only: the shape (which units pair) is established but the operation is not: mnemonic starts with "." or ends with "?"

meta.form_order: the forms list is ordered: the first form of the right width whose mask/value (+ constraints, slot rule) matches wins
meta.bit_numbering: global over the concatenated big-endian units: width-1 = bit 15 of the head; 32-bit: head 31..16, tail 15..0; 48-bit: head 47..32, hi 31..16, lo 15..0; 64-bit (the packet-prefix forms): head 63..48, ext 47..32, U1 31..16, T 15..0
meta.layout: prior-free deterministic packet parser (structure.packet.layout_order): order (s0, I, Fv, -A, K); grammar rules R-r15, R-st1h, R-stimm, H H T T, 5e0d never a tail, .d SP-negative rejection, 0e10 3fc0 c000; prefix forms bcc48/bcc64 (structure.packet.prefix_forms)

structure.unit: 16-bit big-endian halfword; instructions are 1, 2 or 3 units; 16-bit forms are matched with bit 15 masked out unless the form says otherwise

packet.close_bit: bit 15 of a unit = 1 closes the packet (S2); a packet = consecutive units up to and including the first unit with bit 15 = 1
packet.alignment: packets start at addr % 4 == 0 and == 2 alike
packet.head: a unit with bit 15 = 0 that is the first unit of an instruction; a head without tail is a 16-bit op with the packet still open
packet.tail: a unit that completes a 32-bit (1 tail) or 48-bit (2 tails: hi, lo) instruction; only the last unit of the packet has bit 15 (S) = 1
packet.layout: heads first, then tails distributed round-robin among the heads that take tails (S S O O; x008 X hi hi' lo lo'): round r gives the next free tail to every head that takes more than r tails, in head order
packet.groups: a packet is a sequence of GROUPS, each with the heads-first layout; one group = full round-robin, one-instruction groups = contiguous layout (exception handler, b/call + delay slot), mixtures H H T T H T exist; no bit selects the layout: the decoder enumerates every group split and every head/tail assignment and ranks them with the prior-free total order layout_order
packet.layout_order: DETERMINISTIC, PRIOR-FREE total order over the candidate readings of a packet: (s0, I, Fv, -A, K) ascending.  s0 = unknown units (kind other: 1 per unit; kind fmt: 1 per instruction) + the tie-break penalties (tie_breaks); I = number of instructions; Fv = number of heads with a tail whose adjacency contradicts the F pattern (head F = 0 and the next unit has bit 14 = 1 => the tail is ADJACENT; otherwise it is DEFERRED); -A = minus the number of adjacent tails (tail at +1); K = the lexicographic key of the assignment = the sorted tuple of (head index, (tail indices...)) over the instructions (smallest first).  The number of groups is NOT part of the key.  Readings tied on (s0, I, Fv, -A) and decided by K are the <ambiguous> packets unless the tied readings are identical (same heads, tails and mnemonics).
packet.prefix_forms: before the layout enumeration, if the first 3 (4) units of the packet match a packet-prefix form (forms with packet_prefix = true: the bcc48 condition table of 48 bits, its 64-bit twin with the 1e0d extension unit) AND its target guard validates (target = packet start + 2*sext12(T[11:0]) is a packet start of the same function, != the packet itself), those units are one instruction and the REST of the packet is parsed as an independent packet (its delay slot, first_ok = false: no control flow); a failing guard means the prefix form is not taken (normal layout, never .word).  The absolute call/branch prefix (x008 + hi + lo, rule R) is the other prefix rule.

address_views.what: the function table may hold two overlapping images of the same code (a routine mapped twice, each copy with its own ranges): every function is decoded and validated with the packet starts, function starts and function ranges of ITS image (the target guards, callin and du2 use the view's sets; a merged table validates targets of the other image and rejects branches with the wrong function limits)
address_views.image_of_function: which image a function belongs to follows from its file offset and its address range: a property of the function table, not of this table
address_views.plugin: a disassembler that works on one image at a time (one file) has a single view by construction; with both images in one address space the function table must carry the image

br0_cells.what: the (op, tt, B-class, tail distance) cells of the F = 0 branch heads admitted as b<cond>.d (forms *_f0s0 and the F = S = 0 .d forms that already covered blt.d, beq.d, bltu.d, (a,1) bgtu.d, (c,3) bltu.d); B-class: B0 = B == 0, B15 = B == 15, B = any other B; distance = tail at +1 or +2 (S = 0)
br0_cells.covered_by_FS0_forms: the cells blt.d, beq.d, bltu.d, (a,1) bgtu.d, (a,3) bgt.d and (c,3) bltu.d are read by the F = S = 0 .d forms of conds.decode_branch32 (any B class, tail at +1 or +2, rA = r14 allowed), which are tried before the R-br0 cells: no *_f0s0 entry for them
br0_cells.weak_note: the five weak cells validate mostly by chance and are admitted only at the origins of a live trace, identified by (function, offset) so that two copies of the same routine read alike; a plugin without the trace omits them (constraint br0_cells_live never holds)

kties.what: the readings of a packet tied on (s0, I, Fv, -A) are captured during the first pass over the function; after the whole function is decoded a second pass applies, in order, dedup -> nowaw -> du2 -> line and re-parses the packet with the chosen key; the packets the cascade cannot decide stay ambiguous and K decides them
kties.dedup: readings whose multiset of instruction texts (without addresses) is identical are not an ambiguity: keep the K reading (reproducible from the bytes)
kties.nowaw: the packet does not write the same register twice: if exactly one reading has no double write (kinds alu/alu32/mov/movi/movi21/ld/dsp/mul/mov32/movi32/mem16/bit/dspacc/csr/io; the base of a [rA]+ access counts as a destination) it is chosen; if several, they keep competing; if all have one, no decision (reproducible from the bytes)
kties.du2: differential use-definition score over the function context: only the registers whose role differs between the readings score (forward: use +1 (+1 more if not live-in), arg +1, dead -1.5, clobber -0.75; backward: def +1 (+1 more for a sole consumer, named readers only), ret +1, live/arg +0.5, clobbered -1.5, undef -1), window of eight packets, decision margin 1; no decision when every live reading has a double write (reproducible with the function table: the same knowledge the target guards use)
kties.line: vote of the same source line in non-tied packets of other functions: NOT reproducible from the bytes (needs the debug line table): a table-only decoder leaves these ties to K
kties.callin: in the score (not the cascade): a relative call whose target lies strictly inside a known function pays -1.5 like a target outside a boundary; needs the function table
kties.args: the du2 oracle keeps FOUR argument registers r0-r3 although the ABI passes eight (structure.registers.abi): with eight the ties are slightly more numerous and one live example becomes ambiguous; a calibration of the original decoder
kties.effect: the cascade decides most of the real ties; a plugin decoding packet by packet without function context reproduces the K key

packet.renames_post_layout: the renames add st.w [sp], #imm14 (stimmsp_st_w_sp, of mov32 r14 / st.w?), the R-1eX0F0 renames of .1eX0 (x1e0F0_add_q / x1e0F0_ld_h_q / x1e0F0_ld_hu_q), the split forms of group lownib (structure.packet.post_layout_splits, applied by their own procedure, not by the generic rename pass) and the fusion op72_q (structure.packet.post_layout_fusion); the spfix_sub_sp rename is gone (R-spsub is a parser form). /14: the forms with rename_only = true (+ rename_from) are NOT used by the parser (never pair units, never change the score); after the layout is decided an instruction whose reading is in rename_from (mnemonics or '@kind') and whose units match the form (mask + constraints with the packet context: head_index, tail_adjacent, ctx) is relabelled (mnemonic, kind, text); the 16-bit ones replace .hword / .ctl15 / .sub? units, the 32-bit ones .1eX0 / .word / .7e pairs, the 48-bit one the mov32/add 3eX0 trio

post_layout_splits.what: AFTER the layout (the score is untouched) some 32-bit pairs are undone into two 16-bit readings and some bare .hword units are renamed, with the forms of group lownib (split_role): R-slot4n: a pair read .op4t0 / .op4t1 / .op4t3 whose head is op 4 with F = 0 and S = 0 and whose single tail is the NEXT unit with S = 0, low 12 bits > 1 and not the ior/iow tail shape ((unit & 0x7bff) != 0x4000): head -> stslot_F0 / stslot_F0_q (k = m:h:rrr:o3), tail -> its split-tail reading; R-op4imm: a pair read .op4imm whose head is op 4 with S = 0 (F free) and whose single tail has F' = 0 and tt in {00, 01}, ONLY when the tail has a named split-tail reading: head F = 1 -> stslot_S0_pos1, head F = 0 -> stslot_F0 in a 2-unit packet / stslot_F0_q in a longer one, tail -> its split-tail reading; S0-slot: a bare .hword unit at INSTRUCTION POSITION 1 of the packet (not the unit index) with F = 1, S = 0, low 12 bits > 1 and (m = 0 or op != 0) -> stslot_S0_pos1 (o2 = 1) / ldslot_S0_pos1_q (o2 = 0); nowaw guardian over-: a new reading whose destination (WAW kinds, stores excluded) is also written by another instruction of the packet returns its ORIGINAL entry whole (both units of a split); S3 (applied before-, no guardian): a bare .hword unit [0][0][1][1][rrr][x][B][o3 0 00] in the first slot of a multi-unit packet -> ldslot_S3_F0; a bare .hword closer [1][0][1][1][rrr][x][B][o3 1 00] of a multi-unit packet -> stslot_S3_F0 (low 12 bits > 1)
post_layout_splits.split_tail_reading: the 16-bit reading of the tail unit of a split pair, in order: slot family with F = 1 and S = 0 (low 12 bits > 1; m = 0 or op != 0) -> stslot_S0_pos1 (o2 = 1) / ldslot_S0_pos1_q (o2 = 0); op 4 / op c with F = 0 (S free) -> stslot_F0 / stslot_F0_q (by h / m); else the ordinary 16-bit reading of the table in tail position (named or not: for R-slot4n an unnamed tail is kept as it reads; for R-op4imm an unnamed tail means no split)
post_layout_splits.order: S3 -> R-slot4n / R-op4imm / S0-slot (one pass over the instructions in packet order, then the guardian) -> be79 prefix -> the post-layout renames of structure.packet.renames_post_layout (R-op72 fusion first)
post_layout_splits.effect: most of the .op4t0 / .op4t1 / .op4t3 / .op4imm pairs and a third of the bare .hword units are renamed; a few dozen new readings are reverted by the guardian

post_layout_fusion.what: after the layout and before the other renames, two ADJACENT one-unit instructions whose readings are movi (head [0][F][0][h][rrr][0][b][0111]: F = 0, m = 0, x = 0, bit 3 = 0) and the 16-bit op 2 with m = h = 0 and x = 1 (asr? rA, #b'; S and F' free) with the SAME rrr are replaced by ONE two-unit instruction op72? rA, #2b, asr#b' (form op72_q, fuse_pair = true); the lsl cell (x = 0 in the second unit) is NOT fused; the pair does not count as a double write in the R-waw score
post_layout_fusion.effect: a few dozen fusions, all right after a DSP operation

grammar_rules.R-loopA: explicit layout candidate [op f head at 0 -> tail at +1 or +2][16-bit op at 1 when the tail is at +2] + the rest of the packet parsed as a group, whenever the head is an op f with bit 15 = 0 in the first slot and the pair reads `loop #N` (forms loop_imm_*: the F' = 0 tail only at +2; `loop #N?` heads with m = 1 are NOT added explicitly: they only pair through the ordinary grammar); the same score decides.  The group grammar alone drops the candidate when the middle unit has no named 16-bit reading (it prefers fewer bare unnamed heads): 408f 4434 2012 3630 c290 = loop #4 || .slot? || add
grammar_rules.R-brHHTT: explicit candidate [branch head F = 0 (op 8/9/a/c/d, bit 15 = 0) at 0 -> tail at 2][op 0/1 head at 1 -> tail at 3] + the rest (units 4..n-1 parsed as a group) in packets of >= 5 units, when units 2 and 3 have S = 0 and F' = 1, the branch reads kind br with a validated target (packet start of the same function) and the second pair reads ld/st; the b111 context forms accept this layout (ctx b111_layout): 2609 0c20 4218 7054 ... = bne.d r3!, #1 || ld.bu r2, [r6+0x54]
grammar_rules.R-b111pre: explicit candidate: the H H T T of type 111 (st.b / ld.bu, R-offb) as the PREFIX of a packet of >= 5 units: heads op 0/1 at 0 and 1 (bit 15 = 0), tails at 2 and 3 with S = 0 and F' = 1 and at least one tt = 11, both pairs reading ld/st (hhtt mode) + the rest parsed as a group; the b111 context forms accept the prefix (ctx b111_layout), and the P2W (= 2 mod 4 word offsets) and P2H (odd .h offsets) alignment exemptions apply to the prefix too
grammar_rules.R-b111ctl: explicit candidate in packets of exactly 4 units: [op e head F = 0 (b / call) at 0 -> tail at 2][op 1 head at 1 -> tail at 3] with unit 2 S = 0 and F' = 1, tt = 10/11, and unit 3 S = 1, when the branch / call reads with a target and the second pair reads ld/st (the round-robin of the type-111 store after a control head, which the group grammar does not generate); the b111 forms accept it (ctx b111_layout): 400e 5c01 654c f8e2 = b || [d] st.b r0, [sp+0xe3]
grammar_rules.R-p4u4 / bzsd: see the context forms bz_s_P4_u4 (4-unit packets, validated target) and bz_s_P4_u3 (3-unit packets, target beyond the packet, delay slot not writing rA), applied after the layout like bz_s_P4 / bz_s_P5; the rest of the packet is re-parsed as the delay slot
grammar_rules.R-stabs0: the st.abs head ?cX6 (the two-tail store head class) also takes the hi [0][0][1][imm13] (bit 14 = 0) + lo [1][0][lo14 = 0 mod 4] (form st_abs_hiF0), contiguous or deferred after a 2-unit call / b head (round-robin)
grammar_rules.R-w6h1 loop guard: the W6 h = 1 first-slot cell st.h rB, [r{8+rrr}] (form st_h16_f_slot0_h1) is NOT read when x = 0, B in {0, 1} and the unit at +1 or +2 of the packet is a [S][0][11][d12] tail whose last = pc + d12 is a packet start of the same function after the head (the unit is the head of `loop r{8+rrr}`: 560f 7d06 300a = loop r11; ctx not_loop_reg_head)
grammar_rules.R-spsub: the op 0 pair with rA = rB = sp (1ce0 / 5ce0) + the closing tail [1][F'][01][f12] at +1 or +2 is sub r14, #f12/2 with any F / F'
grammar_rules.R-movi6d: the .movi6? closer of a packet whose first instruction is a validated branch (br / br16d at unit 0, target a packet start of the same function) is movi rA, #simm6 (form movi6_dsbr, ctx delay_slot_of_validated_branch): named in the score and renamed after the layout
grammar_rules.beq9sp: the F = S = 0 beq.d of op 9 (form beq_imm8_d) with the ADJACENT tail and rA = sp (m = 0, h:rrr = 14) is not a branch: the form falls through (constraint any(rA != 14, m == 1, tail_adjacent == false))
grammar_rules.R-r15: the 16-bit reading ld.w/st.w r15,[r15+off] (?ff2/?ff6/?ffa/?ffe) is not a form: unnamed (.hword; form r15_r15_ldst16_hword); it is the head of a short backward b/call (hi10 = 0x3ff)
grammar_rules.R-st1h: op 1 + tail [S][0][10][off12] (F' = 0, tt = 10; S = F or F = 1, S = 0) = st.h rB,[rA+off12] (forms st_h_Fp0_*) only with the tail DEFERRED (+2 or farther: tail_adjacency defer; at +1 the two units are 16-bit ops); in the first slot a validated b.s head (5cX1/7cX1 whose target is a packet start of the same function) keeps its 16-bit reading (guard head_not_validated_bs)
grammar_rules.R-stimm: tie-break: a store-of-immediate triple [0][F][00][000][x][B][0000] + [0][1][L][imm13] + lo that the reading does NOT form pays +0.75 (F = 1, or F = 0 with imm13 = 0, lo with bit 15 = 1) and, restricted, also the triple 4XX0 4000/6000 lo with lo S = 0 (the packet continues) and imm14 < 0x100 (with imm >= 0x100 the rule destroyed ld.h || ld.h pairs)
grammar_rules.H H T T: 4-unit packets only: the explicit candidate [h0][h1][t0 S=0][t1 S=1] with h0/h1 heads of op 0/1 (low nibble 0/1, bit 15 = 0), t0 with bit 15 = 0, F' = 1, tt != 11, t1 with bit 15 = 1, F' = 1, tt != 11, when BOTH pairs (h0, t0) and (h1, t1) decode as named ld/st (the first head may be hi(1010)-shaped, it can never be a hi syllable in the first slot, and the second too when the first is not a head of the 48-bit family: the not_hi1010 constraint of the F != S memory forms is ignored for them); plus the tie-break +1.0 for two IDENTICAL units of the packet read with different roles (head with tail / 16-bit op without destination / 16-bit op with destination (kinds alu, alu32, mov, movi, movi21, ld, dsp, mul, mov32, movi32, mem16, bit, dspacc, csr, io)) or both as 16-bit ops with a destination (4431 4431 = mov r3,r2 || mov r3,r2 is not compiler output)
grammar_rules.5e0d never a tail: any assignment that gives the unit 5e0d (.ctl15) as a tail of another head is invalid (5e0d only appears at k <= 1 with the next unit having bit 14 = 0)
grammar_rules.R-ctl15: 5e0d / 1e0d are never a HEAD WITH A TAIL either (never_head_with_tail); after the layout 5e0d/1e0d/de0d are nop.ctl (form nop_ctl); 5e0d stays the U0 of the bcc48 prefix bgt.l r0, #255 and 1e0d the extension unit of bcc64
grammar_rules.H1: a unit with bits 12:9 = 1010 and bit 15 = 0 is a hi syllable of the 48-bit family ONLY when a family head claims it in the chosen reading (the 48-bit forms); otherwise it is a normal head with base/source r10 and every 32-bit form accepts it (no not_hi1010 constraints any more); a lone hi-shaped unit is .hi, and the unit after it .lo, only when a 48-bit-family head precedes it in the packet and the previous instruction is unnamed (context rule hi_lo_fam_before); the forced decode_memFS of H H T T heads is subsumed
grammar_rules.R-c48tab: an op 0 head admits hi + lo when imm32 = head[13:9]:hi[12:0]:lo[13:0] is in the 48-bit value table (forms c48tab_*; at k = 0 the hi is admitted only if head:hi can complete a table value); 47 constants
grammar_rules.R-bcc2: a branch head with F = 1 in slot 0 (op 8/9/a/c/d) + a tail with S = 0, F' = 1 EXACTLY at +2 is b<cond>.d; the rest of the packet is the delay slot
grammar_rules.W14: text only (field type offw): the word displacement of the two-unit ld.w/st.w has 14 bits (f12 = 2 mod 4 -> +0x1000 + (f12 & ~3)); the alignment check counts that class as aligned; the layout score still charges +0.5 to f12 = 1/2 mod 4 except the = 2 mod 4 class in the H H T T / H H T T C layout (P2W, tie_breaks)
grammar_rules.post-layout renames: BF_SEL (bfsel_* of .bf? by cell with the nowaw guardian ctx bf_dst_not_written), NEGQ (negq_* ld.w? / st.w? of the = 1 and = 3 < 0x800 word classes), spfix (spfix_add_sp of ld.w with destination sp, spfix_sub_sp of .ldF0? / ld.h? with rA = rB = sp), the R-movi6F0 DSP-context revert (hword_0Xff_dsp of movi); text only, no effect on the layout
grammar_rules..d SP-negative rejection: an op 5 head with base SP (rA = r14, m = 0) and B even never takes a tail with (b10, s) = (0, 1): the ld.d/st.d forms carry the constraint, so no 32-bit form matches and the head stays a 16-bit op
grammar_rules.0e10 3fc0 c000: the trio head op 0 bits 11:8 = 0xE + hi with L = 1 + lo with bit 15 = 1 that is the whole packet = add r1, r1, #0x3ff00000 (form add32_0eX0_L1 with packet_len == 3; an explicit layout candidate)
grammar_rules.loop# F = 1 adjacent S = 0: the loop #N form with head F = 1 and a tail with S = 0 ADJACENT (+1) is excluded (the two units are 16-bit ops); at +2 it is valid (form loop_imm_F1S0 with tail_adjacency 2)
grammar_rules.cells by position: the identical-bit cells are separated by the unit index k of the head inside the packet (constraints head_index / head_pos_ge): cell A [0][F][0][0][rrr][x][B][1010] at k = 0 of a multi-unit packet = ld.w? rB,[rA+0xc|0x14] (form ld_w16_A_k0); cell C [1][1][1][0][rrr>0][0][B<=11][0110] at k >= 2 = mfacc? rA, A(B/3).(B%3) (form mfacc_q_C_k2); cell E 0XB0 6000 lo: F'' = lo[14] = 0 -> add?, F'' = 1 at k = 1 -> st.h? [rB],#imm14, at k >= 2 -> add? (forms cellE_*); these are renames that do not change the layout
grammar_rules.R-img: per-image address views (see address_views): the target guards, callin and du2 use the packet starts / function starts / function ranges of the image of the function being decoded
grammar_rules.R-tgt: a known target is a VALIDATION FILTER, never a partition: b.s with bit 15 = 0 (b_s_open) and the short b (b_near) need a packet start (b.s: of the same function; b: of any function of the image) OR a function start; the F = S = 0 branch cells, bne.d #-1 (fall through on failure) and loop with F' = 1 (.word) need a packet start of the same function; the filter only removes false readings (no encoded target of these forms lies inside a packet), while a partition would break valid packets
grammar_rules.R-br0: a branch head with F = 0 in slot 0 (op 8/9/a/c, m:h:rrr != 14) + a tail with S = 0, F' = 1 at +1 or +2 is b<cond>.d; the grammar of the op a / op c heads with F = 0 admits the [0][1][tt] tail at the first tail round (op 8/9/d already did)
grammar_rules.R-rets: 1ef1 in slot 0 = ret.s.d (form ret_s_d); loop with B = 1 = loop.b1? (form loop_b1_q, slot 0, last validated); R-bcc2 requires target != pc
grammar_rules.R-bzs5: context rule bz_s_P5 (see context_rules): 4X?5/6X?5 with bit 15 = 0 in slot 0 whose best reading is unnamed = bz.s with delay slot (unconditional in 2-unit packets, target-validated in longer ones)
grammar_rules.R-b111: the type-111 tails ([S][1][11][f12]) are ld.bu (op 0) / st.b (op 1) with the byte displacement offb; a tail that is also a named 16-bit op is admitted ONLY in the 2-unit H T packet (adjacent closing tail, head at unit 0) and in the H H T T layout (context forms of group b111); the H H T T candidate admits tt = 11 tails; the grammar admits the op 0 tail only adjacent, at the first tail round, with F = S = 1 and B != 15, never an O syllable with an op 7 head in the packet
grammar_rules.R-op1fs: the F != S tails of op 1 with tt = 00 (ld.b) / 10 (st.h) (head F = 1, tail S = 0 F' = 1) enter the grammar and the layout EXACTLY at +2 (forms mem_ld_b_t4_F1S0 / mem_st_h_t6_F1S0, tail_adjacency 2 with UNDO semantics: at any other distance the two units are 16-bit ops)
grammar_rules.R-hhttF0: an op 0 head + [S][0][01|10][f12] tail at +2 that the table reads .word is ld.h? / ld.hu? (named, inside the score) when it is the second head of an H H T T whose first head is a named ld/st (context forms hhttF0_*, ctx hhtt_second_head)
grammar_rules.R-F0d: in [op 0 head F = 1 with rA = sp][adjacent unit with bits 15:14 = 01][F' = 0 tail tt = 01/10 at +2] the head's tail is the deferred one (context forms rf0d_*, ctx f0d_triple: ld.h? / ld.hu? rB, [sp+off]); the middle unit is then read with the first-slot 16-bit cell when named and not control / not a write of sp (context rule f0d_middle_unit, text only); B = sp with x = 0 excluded; RF0D=all (any base) refuted
grammar_rules.R-slotm1: the R7 first-slot S = 0 slot also with m = 1 (k >= 32), only with op 4/8/c (k mod 4 != 0) and the rest of the packet named without a ? (context forms ldslot_S0_m1 / stslot_S0_m1, ctx rest_named_no_q); the op 0 sub-family is NOT a slot
grammar_rules.R-stimm16: the store-of-immediate triple with L = 1 and imm27 >= 0x10000 reads .stimm16? (format: one unnamed unit in s0) so that the H H T T ld/st pair of the same units wins (forms stimm16_q_*, before st_h_imm)
grammar_rules.R-op2sh: the 16-bit op 2 with m = h = 0 is lsl / asr rA, #B (forms lsl16_imm / asr16_imm, ? variants): in-place shift by immediate, x = direction, never a bank bit; replaces addi rA, #simm4 (form addi4 retired)
grammar_rules.R-bfpair: [op 7][op 7][tail tt = 01 S = 0][tail tt = 01 S = 1] with both cells valid = two fxtu / fxts / fup also outside the named cells (context forms bfpair_*, group hhtt, ctx bfpair); the 4-unit round-robin produces the layout, the forms name it
grammar_rules.R-mtacc: mtcsr? #0x30-0x3e, rs1 also when the tail is a named 16-bit op (form mtcsr_q: constraint any(tail_not_named16, csr in 0x30-0x3e)); the other mtcsr? numbers keep the gate
grammar_rules.c003 / R-movi6F0: [op 7 rrr = 0][c003] = movi? rB, #-32767 (form movi_m32767_q, sibling of c001); 0Xff with bit 15 = 0 (rrr != 7) = movi rA, #-1 with F = 0 (form movi_m1_F0_S0), reverted to .hword between a DSP head and its tail (hword_0Xff_dsp)
grammar_rules.rsub idiom (not exported): not exported: a (0,110) ld.hu pair in the delay slot of a call preceded (<= 3 packets) by clz and #31 may be rsub? rB, #(f12 >> 1), rA; ld.hu stays the default reading

packet.acceptance: a head may take a tail (or a hi+lo pair) iff some form of this table matches the head and the tail(s); a head may stand alone as a 16-bit unit (named form or .hword) unless listed in must_pair; ret/save/restore never take tails
packet.last_unit_rule: a packet of >= 3 units whose last unit (bit 15 = 1) is a named 16-bit op may also be read as <parse of the first n-1 units> + that op; rule R0: the final closer may ALSO form its own one-unit group even when it has no named 16-bit reading (layout H T C)
tie_breaks: R-waw: every register written by >= 2 instructions of the reading pays +0.75 (destination = the first operand of an instruction of the WAW kinds alu/alu32/mov/movi/movi21/ld/dsp/mul/mov32/movi32/mem16/bit/dspacc/csr/io, followed by a comma; stores excluded; the R-op72 pair movi rA || asr? rA of the same rrr does not count): ahead of the soft penalties (alin.h / = 2 / movi-tail / 4000: 0.5), equal to the loose O syllable (0.75), below the = 1 / = 3 < 0xf00 word tails (0.8 with al1) and below an unnamed unit (1.0); assumes the parallel execution of the packet (old-value reads)

al1: a ld.w / st.w (also ?) tail with f12 = 1 or 3 mod 4 (< 0xf00, i.e. the misaligned word classes) pays +0.3 MORE than the +0.5 alignment penalty (0.8 in all) so that a double write (0.75) is never traded for a misaligned word access

R-bsnext: a 16-bit b.s with S = 0 in the first slot (form b_s_open) whose target is EXACTLY the next packet (pc + 2n, n = units of the packet) and not a function start pays +2.5 (ctrl -2.5): a null jump; the unit is the op 1 head st.h / st.b rB, [sp+off] of the H T pair (the real tail calls to the adjacent function are kept by the function-start exemption)

P2W / P2H prefix: the P2W (= 2 mod 4 word offsets) and P2H (odd half-word offsets) alignment exemptions of the H H T T / H H T T C layout also apply when H H T T (op 0/1 heads at 0 and 1 with their tails at 2 and 3) is the PREFIX of a packet of >= 5 units and every other instruction lies in units >= 4
sat40 H H T T: a 4-unit packet [op c][op c][tail S = 0, F' = 0, tt = 00, a:X = 8:c][tail idem] that is not read H H T T (pairs 0 -> 2, 1 -> 3) pays +3.0

rf0dpen: a reading with an R-F0d head (forms rf0d_*) whose middle unit (the bare 16-bit op at +1) writes a register that another instruction of the packet also writes pays +1.0; rf0dmidwaw: the middle unit is not re-read with the first-slot cell (context rule f0d_middle_unit) when that reading would double-write
R-movi6d: a .movi6? closer in the delay slot of a validated branch at unit 0 (kind br / br16d, target a packet start of the same function) counts as a NAMED unit in the score (form movi6_dsbr)
an O syllable (unit with bits 13:11 = 111, i.e. 78-7f / f8-ff) that is not the tail of an op 7 head: +0.75
a 16-bit movi with bits 15:14 = 00 used as a tail: +0.5

ld.w/st.w (also ld.w?/st.w?) with a 12-bit offset not multiple of 4, ld.h/st.h odd: +0.5 —: NOT charged when (f12 & 3) == 3 and f12 >= 0xf00; the extrapolated 0x800-0xeff band and f12 = 1/2 mod 4 still pay; the odd .h penalty is kept although R-off.h makes odd offsets legal; not charged to ld.d/st.d (.d) nor to the indexed forms (op 4, tt = 10)

P2W: the +0.5 of a word offset with f12 = 2 mod 4 (= +0x1000, W14) is NOT charged when the reading is H H T T or H H T T C; f12 = 2 mod 4 at k >= 1 keeps paying (noise in the null); P2 global not adopted
callin: a relative call whose target is strictly inside a known function (not its start) scores -1.5 like a target outside a boundary (needs the function table)
the op 0 F = S = 1 pair relabelled add rB, rA, #rot12 (f12 = 1 mod 4, form add_FS1_rot12_odd) still pays the alignment penalty +0.5 (text-only relabel)
in 4-unit packets, two IDENTICAL units read with different roles, or both as 16-bit ops with a destination: +1.0 (see grammar_rules "H H T T")
R-pen / R-stimm restricted: a store-of-immediate triple not formed by the reading: +0.75 (see grammar_rules R-stimm)
loose .hi/.hilo syllable: +0.25
loose 4000 read as nop without closing the packet: +0.5
48-bit hi(1010) family with destination r14/r15: +0.5
a head 1dX6 (st.w rB,[sp+4] shape: F=0 m=0 h=1 rrr=6 x=1 op 6) paired with a tail that is a NAMED 16-bit op: +0.5

rule R7: a bare first-slot unit with bit 15 = 0 of the slot family [0][1][0][h][rrr][x][B][o3 o2 00] (ldslot_S0/stslot_S0), or of the lea? shape [0][0][0][h][rrr][x][B][o 000] with rA != r14 when no other instruction of the packet has a tail, counts as NAMED (unnamed - 1) when every other instruction of the packet is named; it beats .op8?/.word readings but not a named pair

control-flow target not at a packet boundary: +1.5 (needs the boundary set; a branch to a function start: -2, to a boundary: -1; a relative call whose target is a boundary but NOT a function start scores -0.5 instead of +0.5, so a fully named 16-bit reading wins)

a control reading whose form carries a target guard that VALIDATED (b_far, loop_F0, call_F0/b_F0, bcc_F0, beqz_d/bnez_d, call_s_S0): -0.5 — breaks the exact ties against op16 || pair readings of the same units and lets a validated call.s/call beat a pair reading with one instruction less, never a reading with fewer unnamed units
in a packet of >= 4 units a head 4X37-like [0][1][00][000][x][B!=0][0111] followed by its closing e0nn tail (nn in MFCSR_KNOWN) is the canonical mfcsr pair; readings that do not pair them: +0.5

P2H: the +0.5 of an ODD half-word offset (ld.h/ld.hu/st.h: f12 odd = negative by R-off.h) is NOT charged when the reading is H H T T or H H T T C, as P2W for the = 2 word class; exempt f12 = 0x001 (-0x1000) with base sp; outside H H T T it keeps paying (dropping it everywhere breaks valid listings)

R-lr16: a 16-bit ld/st.b|bu|h r15, [rA] (LR as data, kind mem16) without tail pays +0.5: it is a [S][F'][tt][f12] tail with f12[7:4] = 0xf read as a 16-bit op (4871 efff = st.h r7, [r4-0x2]); 2-unit packets only (in longer packets the penalty hurt)
R-align48: a formed 48-bit trio of the hi(1010) family (ld.w / st.w: 4; ld.h / ld.hu / st.h: 2) whose address 0x78000000 | hi[12:0]:lo[13:0] is not a multiple of the access width pays +0.5

R-c48sym: a reading that leaves a head of the 48-bit family [0][F][01][A][B][op 0/4/5/6/7] WITHOUT tails while a later free hi(1010) unit (a 16-bit op or the head of a pair) + its following lo encode a data address ALREADY FORMED by the family elsewhere (structure.packet.c48sym_known_addresses) pays +0.5
equal (s0, I, Fv, -A): the smallest lexicographic key K of the assignment wins; the learned prior of -12 and the number of groups are gone
packet.first_slot: only the first unit of the packet (slot 0) can be control flow: branches, call/b (also with the F' = 0 tail at +2), loop, ret, 16-bit branches (b.s, bz.s/bnz.s, call.s with bit 15 = 1 or 0), beqz.d/bnez.d with F = S = 0, call.abs/b.abs; the same encodings in other slots are mov/add/op C etc.; 32-bit ret (40ff c000), ret? (40ff c800), jr? rB and call rB (sys shape) are NOT restricted to slot 0
packet.control_tail_adjacency: the tail of a branch/call/loop must be at +1 (S = 1) or at +2 at most (S = 0, S S O O layout); tails farther away give random targets.  Exceptions: loop_F0 accepts the tail at +2 with S = 1 (4a0f 5e0d b00c); the control tails with F' = 0 (call_F0/b_F0 [S][0][1L], bcc_F0 [1][0][tt]: tail_adjacency = 2) must be EXACTLY at +2 (a 16-bit op in between): at +1 or +3 they are data; a 3-unit packet [head][op16][tail F' = 0] is always a candidate reading
packet.tail_adjacency_values: 1 = the tail must be the next unit (immediate set-on-compare forms, add_FS12: a farther tail undoes the pair into two 16-bit ops); ctrl = +1 (S = 1) or +2 (S = 0) for control flow, else .word (loop forms with an F' = 0 tail also accept S = 1 at +2); 2 = EXACTLY at +2, else .word for the control forms, two 16-bit ops for loop_imm_F1S0 at +1 and for the ld/st forms (undo); defer = at +2 or FARTHER (an adjacent tail undoes the pair into two 16-bit ops)
packet.delay_slot: when the control instruction does not close the packet (S = 0 tail, or bit 15 = 0 head: call, b, b<cond>.d, beqz.d/bnez.d (F = S = 0), ret.d, b.s, call.s with bit 15 = 0, call rB, call.abs/b.abs), the REST OF THE PACKET is the delay slot: it executes on both paths and the condition uses the values before the slot (no packet has two control instructions); for the F' = 0 tails at +2 the unit between head and tail is the delay slot (and the rest of the packet when the tail has S = 0); nothing shows that the slot reaches the next packet
packet.parallelism: units of a packet execute in parallel (a register loaded in a packet is rarely read again inside the same packet)
packet.setcc_plus2_guard: the +2 guard that nulls a set-on-compare pair whose tail is not adjacent applies ONLY to the immediate forms (heads op 1/4/6: seq/slt/sgt/.scc?/slt_op6/add_FS12, tail_adjacency 1); the register forms of op 7 (seq/slt/sltu rd, rs1, rB as O syllables at +2 in the S S O O layout) are valid
packet.three_unit_F0_candidate: rule R2: a packet of exactly 3 units [head with bit 15 = 0][16-bit unit with bit 15 = 0][closing tail with F' = 0] is always tried as <head + tail at +2> || <middle unit as a 16-bit op> (the plain round-robin enumeration already produces it); the same score decides (validated target or .word)

sys_ops.shape: [0][1][00][rrr][x][B][1111] + [S][1][0][t0][fld][00 0000 0000] (tail & 0xe3ff == 0xc000), F = 1, ss = 0, B != 0, x = 0 or rrr = 0; the tail field fld = t[12:10] selects the family
sys_ops.fld_0: jump to register: B = 15 -> ret (40ff c000, form ret32), other B -> jr? rB; kind jr
sys_ops.fld_1: call rB(!x) (c400: indirect call, rB usually loaded by mov32; 4X8f c400 = call r8!)
sys_ops.fld_2: B = 15 -> ret? (40ff c800: seen after restore, in functions with no other ret)

fld_4.1: cop rA (cache / coprocessor op: rA = address | code 0x04 prefetch-I, 0x09 I-inv, 0x15 D-clean, 0x19 D-inv, 0x1c clean+inv all; MD32 equivalent cop)
fld_4.6: isync? (barrier after iow to MPU/caches; unconfirmed)

sys_ops.F_S_0_twin: the same sys #n with F = 0 on the head and the tail [0][1][01][..][00 0000 0000] (= 5000, bits 11:10 free; S = 0): the pair does NOT close the packet; F = 0 with S = 1: 0 instances
sys_ops.md32_equivalents: ieon 0x07008020 / ieoff 0x07008021 / rti / halt (the MD32 encodings of the same operations)

registers.gpr: two banks of 16 x 32-bit general registers: r0-r15 and the high bank r0!-r15!; 4-bit fields h:rrr or B; no r16-r31
registers.lr: r15 (= address of the packet following the call, also for call.abs and the 48-bit call)
registers.args: r0-r7 (r0-r3 most used), stack args > r7 stored with st.w [sp], #imm
registers.callee_saved: r8-r10, r12, r13 and r8!-r14! via save w; r11 caller-saved
registers.abi: EIGHT argument registers r0-r7 (a double occupies two); argument 9+j in stack slot j = [sp+4j] (ldslot / stslot rB, #k: k = argument 9+k, k = P-9 for the last of P arguments); return r0 (r0:r1); r14 = SP, r15 = LR; r8-r13 preserved.  Measured on the call packets (writes of r4-r7 by arity, live-in reads of the callee, literals in argument positions 5-8 as movi r{i-1}, stslot before calls with more than eight arguments) and confirmed by bit-exact examples.  (The du2 oracle of the K-tie cascade keeps r0-r3: structure.packet.kties.args)
registers.high_bank: the bank bits are per operand: x (head/unit bit 8) = bank of rB (destination / data register: 16-bit mov rB!, 32-bit ld/st data, op 7/op C second source rB!, ior/iow data, slot family rB!), m (head/unit bit 13) = bank of rA (source / base register: mov rB, rA!; ld/st [rA!+off]; add rB, rA!, #imm), and for op 7 (78-7b/7c/7d) ss & 2 (head bit 13) = rs1 in the high bank (21f7 73a6 = asr r8, r0!, #31); odd X cells of op C / 78-7b = rd in the high bank; i4 of cmov = bank of rB; on the 48-bit heads (mov32, lea/ld/st hi(1010)) x = 1 = destination in the high bank.  16 registers (r0!-r15!).
registers.accumulators: A0-A3, 3 words each (lo, hi, ext); read with mfacc rA, w (w = 3k + part); extended CSR 0x30 + 4k + part (mtcsr? #0x30-0x3e writes them)
registers.csr_classic_note: MD32 classic CSR names, kept ONLY for the `csr` field type of the md32 plugin: on the uSIP there is NO classic CSR bank reachable through op 4 (the op 4 + [S][100][x][d] shape is PORT I/O, ior/iow; the earlier mfcr/mtcr forms are gone); the exception-handler stores 45N1 d0xx are st.w rN!, [r2+0x40+4N] = the HIGH GPR BANK

io_ports.shape: ior rB, [rA] / iow rB, [rA]: rA holds the port number (0x100-0x805 observed); same port map as the MD32 ior/iow
io_ports.0x320-0x364: caches / MPU (0x330/0x340 caches, 0x350 MPU enable bit 16)

registers.csr_extended: 0x01-0x3e via mfcsr rB, #nn (tail F' free) and mtcsr #nn, rA (op 7 head with B = 0, x = 0 + [S][F'][10][0][1][00][nn]; 0x20-0x26 confirmed by the exception handler, 0x30-0x3e / 0x10-0x14 = mtcsr?); names in csr_extended_names; 0x30-0x3e = A0-A3 x (lo, hi, ext); 0x10/0x11/0x13/0x14 = DSP status flags (unnamed); 0x03 unnamed

csr_extended_names.0x02: pc_next (PC of the next packet at the exception)

registers.flags: none: all branches are compare-and-branch; no cmp instruction

structure.hardware_loops: loop rX, last=pc+disp12: counter in rX, END ADDRESS INCLUSIVE (last instruction of the body), body 1-16 instructions, nestable (extended CSRs 0x21-0x29 = lc/ls/le 0-2, 0x20 = lf); the tail is [S][F'][11][disp12] with S and F' free (forms loop and loop_F0); ls = address of the first packet after the loop packet, le = last; sys #3 cancels the loop

conditions.index: tail bits 13:12 (t2) select the condition inside each op; imm8 = x:B:t[11:9] signed (unsigned for op 8 t2 < 2)
conditions.delay_variants: F = S = 0 cells: blt.d beq.d (op 9), bltu.d (op 8), bgt.d bgtu.d (op a), all four op d, bltu.d (op c t2=11), bne.d rA,#-1 (op 9 t2=00 only with imm8 = -1); beqz.d/bnez.d (op c t2 = 01/00, F = S = 0, B in {0, 15}, target validated: shared cell with the op C DSP tails)
conditions.F0S0_tail_variants: the same compare-and-branch with head F = 0 in slot 0 (m:h:rrr != 14) + the tail [0][1][tt] (S = 0, F' = 1) at +1 or +2, only in the cells of structure.packet.br0_cells: decode = the F = S = 1 form with head bit 14 and tail bit 15 forced, mnemonic b<cond>.d, delay slot = the rest of the packet; target validated (!= pc), failure = fall through
conditions.F0_tail_variants: the same compare-and-branch with the tail [1][0][tt] (S = 1, F' = 0) exactly at +2 (head F = 1, m:h:rrr != 14): op 9 tt 0-3, op a tt 1-3, op d tt 2-3; decode = the F' = 1 form with tail bit 14 forced; target must be a packet start of the same function; op 8 and op c excluded
conditions.S0F1_tail_variants: the same compare-and-branch with the tail [0][1][tt] (S = 0, F' = 1) exactly at +2 (head F = 1 in slot 0, m:h:rrr != 14; op 8/9/a/c/d, every cell): decode = the F = S = 1 form with tail bit 15 forced, mnemonic b<cond>.d, the rest of the packet = delay slot; target must be a packet start of the same function (else .word)
conditions.bank_bits: in the 32-bit compare-and-branch forms the 5-bit field rA5 = m:h:rrr is rA = h:rrr with m = the BANK of rA; no r16-r31

bcc48.shape: U0 [0][1][m][h][rrr][x][B][op b-f] + U1 [0][1][m'][h'][rrr'][x'][0000 0000] + T [S][1][00][d12]; compared register = x:B of U0; cond = (op, m'h'): h' = 0 -> {le, lt}, h' = 1 -> {ge, gt}, m' = strict
bcc48.immediate: op c-f: imm = (h:rrr of U0):(rrr':x' of U1), sign = m of U0 (simm9 = m:h:rrr:rrr':x'); op c: UNSIGNED imm9 = m:h:rrr:rrr':x'; op b: rA = h:rrr of U0 with m = bank, rrr':x' = 0
bcc48.other cells: bcc48?; beqz.l does not exist (op d 11 with m = 1, h:rrr = 1111, U1 = 7f00 = bgt.l rB, #-1)

displacements.bcond_imm8: disp = sext9(t[0]:t[8:1]) * 2 (tail bit 0 is the sign)
displacements.bcond_zero: disp = sext16(t[0]:B:t[11:1]) * 2 (also beqz.d/bnez.d with F = S = 0: B in {0, 15})
displacements.b16: disp = sext7(D:d6) * 2 with D = bit 13 (d6 - 64 when D = 1); bz.s with bit 15 = 0: 2*d6 forward; call.s with bit 15 = 0 (call_s_S0): sext7(D:d6) * 2, target must be a function start
displacements.call_b: disp = sext22(b0:hi10:lo11) * 2 (b0 = tail bit 0 = bit 21; hi10 = head bits 13:4; lo11 = tail bits 11:1); near b: hi10 in {0, 0x3ff} with b0 == hi10[9]; the same fields with the F' = 0 tail [S][0][1L] at +2 (call_F0 / b_F0, head F = 1)
displacements.ctrl_tail_F0: control tails with F' = 0 — op E [S][0][1L][lo11][b0] (call_F0/b_F0: 22-bit disp as call_b), op 9/a [1][0][tt][imm3][d9] (9-bit disp as bcond_imm8), op d [1][0][tt][d12] (12-bit disp as bcond_reg) — sit EXACTLY at +2 of a head with F = 1 (tail_adjacency 2); the unit in between is the delay slot; targets validated (function start for call, packet start of the same function for b/bcc)
displacements.ctrl_tail_S0F1: (R-bcc2): the branch tails [0][1][tt][...] (S = 0, F' = 1) of op 8/9/a (9-bit disp), op c/d (12-bit / zero forms) at EXACTLY +2 of a head with F = 1 in slot 0: same displacement formulas as the F = S = 1 cells; the rest of the packet is the delay slot; target != pc
displacements.ctrl_tail_F0S0: (R-br0): the same tails at +1 or +2 of a head with F = 0 in slot 0: op 8/9/a imm8 = x:B:t[11:9], disp = sext9(t0:t8..1)*2; op c tt = 2/3 rB = B (bank x), disp = sext12(t0:t11..1)*2 (op c tt < 2 would be sext16(t0:B:t11..1)*2: not admitted)
displacements.bz_s_P5: (R-bzs5): bz.s with bit 15 = 0 and bit 3 = 0 (4X?5/6X?5) in slot 0: dest = pc + 2*(d6 - 64*D) = sext7(D:d6)*2 (D = bit 13; the P4 twin 4X?d is forward-only 2*d6)
displacements.bcc48: target = packet start (= address of U0, slot 0) + 2 * sext12(T[11:0]) (48- and 64-bit forms); must be a packet start of the same function and != the packet itself
displacements.loop: last = pc + disp12 (unsigned bytes, inclusive); loop #N: the same d12 (!= 0)
displacements.fam48: register value = 0x78000000 | hi[12:0]:lo[13:0] (DSP view of the data space; hi[12:9] = 1010 so value = 0x7D000000 + imm23); MCU alias = value - 0x60000000
displacements.pc: pc = address of the head unit (r15 = address of the packet following the call, also for call.abs, call rB and the F' = 0 call at +2)

immediates.rot(f, n): rotated field, bit 0 = sign: imm = sext((f >> 1) | ((f & 1) << (n - 1)), n); used by op 0/1 (rot12), op 6/2 (rot10), .op4imm (rot12), sne/scmp? (rot10), add_FS12 (rot12 over the whole op 0 F=0 + [1][1][00] cell)
immediates.movi21: V20 = b: 0: t0: f12[0]: m: h: rrr: f12[11:1]; b = 1 (head op b) = movi? (not a C constant)
immediates.movhi: /13: value = V20 << 12 with V20 = i: t1: t0: f12[0]: m: h: rrr: f12[11:1] (the movi21 layout; field type movhi = the collected bits << 12); the admission is the uniform-middle-bits cell of (form movhi) or the small cell op 8 m = h = rrr = 0 + [1][1][00][f12 even != 0] with V20 = f12 >> 1 (form movhi_small)
immediates.imm32 (48 bits): mov32 / add rB, rB, #imm32 of the op 0 + hi + lo family: imm32 = head[13:9] << 27 | hi[12:0] << 14 | lo[13:0] (field val; L = hi bit 13 selects add); the hi(1010) family with head[13:9] = 15 keeps the alias lea/add [#0x78000000 | imm27] and head[13:9] = 8 with L = 0 is lea?
immediates.op72?: (R-op72): op72? rA, #k, asr#b over the fused pair movi rA, #k (k = 2 x head bits 7:4) || asr? rA, #b (b = tail bits 7:4): format-level ?
immediates.add / st.h? by value (addq): the F = 0 F' = 1 L = 1 x = 0 triple (and the E2 cells 0XB0 6000 lo): imm in SAT16 = {0x7fff, 0x8000, 0x7ffe, 0x3fff, 0x1fff, 0xfff} -> st.h? [rB], #imm; imm >= 0x400 otherwise -> add rB, rB, #imm; no bit separates them (selection by value)
immediates.loop#: (R-loopcnt): N = head bits 13:5 = m:h:rrr:x:B[3:1] taken as is (field type loopn REDEFINED: the collected bits, no +1); bit 4 of the head = B[0] is an open flag (field b4). ( said N = ((rrr:x:B) >> 1) + [x != 0 or B != 0]: its confirmed example had iteration 0 peeled; superseded, N = ((rrr:x:B) >> 1) + [x != 0 or B != 0] (field type loopn over the 8 bits rrr:x:B of the head; bit 4 of the head = B[0] is an open flag)
immediates.movi6: stand-alone [1][0][0][h][rrr][1][B][o3 111]: sext6(x:B:o3) = -32..-1; the F = 1 closer cXff (x=1, B=15, o3=1) = movi rA, #-1
immediates.ld/st off12: ld.w/st.w (two-unit forms with the [S][F'][tt][f12] tail): W14, field type offw = a 14-bit word displacement: f12 = 0 mod 4 -> +f12; f12 = 2 mod 4 -> +0x1000 + (f12 & ~3); (f12 & 3) == 3 with f12 >= 0x800 -> 4 * sext10(f12 >> 2) = -0x1000 + (f12 & ~3); f12 = 1 mod 4 and 3 mod 4 below 0x800: negative by the formula (-0x2000 + (f12 & ~3) / -0x1000 + ...) but without confirmed example: printed +f12 and renamed ld.w?/st.w? after the layout; NOT the op 4 off11 cell (.op4t0); ld.h/ld.hu/st.h: field type offh = unsigned f12 when even, f12 - 0x1001 when odd; ld.b / ld.bu / st.b: field type offb = sext12(f12[0]: f12[10:1]: f12[11]) (bit 11 of the field = bit 0 of the displacement, bit 0 = sign; replaces sext12 + 0x800 = +1 and sext11 + flag)
immediates.op2 shift (16 bits): (R-op2sh): [1][F][0][0][rrr][x][B][0010] = lsl (x = 0) / asr (x = 1) rA, #B with rA = r0-r7 and B = count 1..15 (the former addi rA, #sext4(B) with x as bank)
immediates.movi? #-32767: (c003): op 7 head with rrr = 0 + the exact tail c003 = movi? rB, #-32767 (0xffff8001 if rot16; the sibling of c001 = #-32768)
immediates.loop.b1?: the loop head with B = 1 (bit 4) and x = 0: same last = pc + d12 (inclusive, > pc); the meaning of B is open
immediates.bit-field (op 7 tag 01): tail [S][F'][01][c:2][w:5][p:5]: width w = a (bits 9:5), position pos = rotr5(p) = (p >> 1) | ((p & 1) << 4) (field pos = bit ranges [0,0],[4,1]); c = 00 fxtu, 01 fxts, 10 fup; 18 named cells (the named bit-field cells + extu/asr16/osl); the rest .bf?
immediates.c48_table: 16 imm32 values admitted as 48-bit mov32/add (forms c48tab_*) by lookup; not a bit rule
immediates.movi? #-32768: (bf32): op 7 head with rrr = 0 + the exact tail c001 = movi? rB, #-32768 (0xffff8000 = the 16-bit minimum)
immediates.op 4/5 off11: f12 & 0x7ff, bit 11 = flag (ld.w?/st.w? op 4 t=00 / .op4t*, .op5t*); op 5 t = 00: ld.d/st.d tail [S=F][1][00][d][b10][v9][s]: offset = 4*v9 - 2048*s = 4 * sext10 (simm scale 4), d = direction (1 = store), b10 = open flag, (b10, s) = (1, 1) = .op5b10?
immediates.cell A: ld.w? rB, [rA + 12 + 8x] (16-bit cell A at unit index 0: 0xc with x = 0, 0x14 with x = 1; field off = x * 8 + 12)
immediates.addsp: r14 += 4 * sext7(m:x:B:o3) (16-bit, F = 0, rA = r14, op 0/8; imm7 != 0; closer, or first slot with |imm7| >= 17)
immediates.lea_sp: lea? rA, [sp + 4 * (x:B:o3)] (16-bit, F = 0, m = 0, op 0/8, rA != r14; stand-alone or first slot with the rest of the packet named 16-bit ops)
immediates.st_w_sp16: st.w rB, [sp + off] with off = 4 (op 6, x = 1), 12 (op e, x = 0), 20 (op e, x = 1) for F = 0, m = 0, rA = r14
immediates.slot_k: ldslot/stslot rB(!x), #k: k = h:rrr:o3 (5 bits; o3 = low bit, consecutive slots = consecutive arguments); x = bank of rB, m = 1 -> ? variant; slot base open (frame pointer relative)
immediates.extu: extu rB, rs1, #11, #20 = (rs1 >> 20) & 0x7ff: the (c, a, b) = (0, 11, 9) cell of the two-immediate family (general formula open)

field_types.reg: general register index (4 bits unless noted); "offset": constant added to the field value (rB1 = rB + 1 of ld.d?/st.d?; sh = m + 1 of lsl16_c)
field_types.simm: sign-extended immediate (width = total bits; scale applied when declared: addsp x4)
field_types.disp: signed pc-relative displacement (scale applied) -> target = pc + value (pc_offset is no longer used by any form: call_i48 is retired)
field_types.absaddr: SEG[seg] | value with SEG[seg] = seg << 26 (seg 30 = 0x78000000 = the DSP view of DDR data used by the hi(1010) family)
field_types.flag: 1-bit flag; in format strings {name:text} prints text when the flag is 1 ({x:!} / {m:!} / {ss1:!} print the high-bank "!")
field_types.movhi: value = (collected bits) << 12 (the collected bits are V20 = i:t1:t0:f12[0]:m:h:rrr:f12[11:1] for movhi, f12[11:1] for movhi_small); replaces the 5-bit formula
field_types.offh: (R-off.h): 12-bit half-word offset: value = f when f is even, f - 0x1001 when f is odd (negative, = 2*rot12)
field_types.offw: 12-bit field of a 14-bit word displacement: value = 0x1000 + (f & ~3) when (f & 3) == 2; 4 * sext10(f >> 2) (= -0x1000 + (f & ~3), negative multiple of 4: -2048..-4) when (f & 3) == 3 and f >= 0x800; else f
field_types.offb: (R-offb): 12-bit field of the byte displacement of ld.b / ld.bu / st.b (F = S and F != S): value = sext12(f[0]: f[10:1]: f[11]) = sext12(((f & 1) << 11) | (f & 0x7fe) | (f >> 11)): bit 11 of the field is bit 0 of the displacement, bit 0 of the field is the sign (the same family as offh (bit 12 in f[0]) and offw (bits 13:12 in f[1:0])); printed with sign
field_types.loopn: (loop #N, R-loopcnt): the collected bits (head bits 13:5 = m:h:rrr:x:B[3:1], 9 bits) taken as is: N = raw (printed in decimal); REDEFINED: computed (raw >> 1) + (1 if (raw & 0x1f) != 0 else 0) over rrr:x:B
field_types.bits: list of [hi, lo] ranges in global bit numbering, MSB first, concatenated; ["z", n] = n implicit zero bits

context_rules.name: bz_s_P4_u4
context_rules.rule: form bz_s_P4_u4 — the 4X?d unit (F = 1, m = 0, bit 15 = 0, rA not in {r14, r15}, not 5e0d) opening a packet of exactly FOUR units whose best reading leaves it unnamed (.hword / fmt), with pc + 2*d6 (d6 > 0) a packet start of the same function = bz.s rA; the other three units are re-parsed as the delay slot (no control flow); applied after the layout, after bz_s_P5 / bz_s_P4 and before the R7 gate

context_rules.name: bz_s_P4_u3
context_rules.rule: form bz_s_P4_u3 — the same unit opening a packet of exactly THREE units, bare (no tail) and unnamed in the best reading, with the target a packet start of the same function BEYOND the packet (>= address of the last unit + 2) and whose re-parsed delay slot has no instruction of the WAW kinds (stores excluded) with rA as its destination = bz.s rA + the delay slot; applied after the R7 gate

context_rules.name: target_beyond_packet
context_rules.rule: (bz_s_P4_u3): constraint ctx target_beyond_packet: the pc-relative target is >= the address of the last unit of the packet + 2

context_rules.name: delay_slot_not_writing_rA
context_rules.rule: (bz_s_P4_u3): constraint ctx delay_slot_not_writing_rA: no instruction of the re-parsed delay slot of the WAW kinds (alu/alu32/mov/movi/movi21/ld/dsp/mul/mov32/movi32/mem16/bit/dspacc/csr/io; mnemonics starting with st excluded) has rA (first operand, with sp for r14) as its destination

context_rules.name: not_loop_reg_head
context_rules.rule: constraint ctx not_loop_reg_head of st_h16_f_slot0_h1 (with x = 0 and B in {0, 1}): the unit at +1 or +2 of the packet is NOT a [S][0][11][d12] tail whose last = pc + d12 is a packet start of the same function after the head (else the unit is the head of loop r{8+rrr} and the 16-bit form does not match)

context_rules.name: delay_slot_of_validated_branch
context_rules.rule: constraint ctx delay_slot_of_validated_branch of movi6_dsbr: the first instruction of the packet (unit 0) is of kind br / br16d with a target that is a packet start of the same function, and the unit is a bare closer at a later position; evaluated in the layout score and after the layout

context_rules.name: op4imm_head_multiunit
context_rules.rule: constraint ctx op4imm_head_multiunit of stslot_F0_q: the unit is the F = 0 head of a split .op4imm pair in a packet of more than two units (mixed profile: ?)

context_rules.name: split_unit
context_rules.rule: (structure.packet.post_layout_splits): constraint ctx split_unit of stslot_S0_pos1 / ldslot_S0_pos1_q: the unit is the head (F = 1 of .op4imm) or the re-read tail of a split pair (R-slot4n / R-op4imm), at any instruction position

context_rules.name: b111_layout
context_rules.rule: the ctx b111_layout of the group-b111 forms also holds (c) in the R-brHHTT candidate, (d) in the R-b111pre prefix (H H T T at units 0-3 of a >= 5-unit packet with every other instruction in units >= 4) and (e) in the R-b111ctl layout

context_rules.name: bz_s_P5
context_rules.rule: form bz_s_P5 — a first-slot unit [0][1][D][h][rrr][d6][101] with bit 3 = 0 (4X?5/6X?5, bit 15 = 0, rA not in {r14, r15}) whose best reading has no tail and is unnamed (.hword / fmt) is bz.s rA, pc + 2*(d6 - 64*D) with the rest of the packet as its delay slot: unconditionally in a packet of exactly two units, in longer packets only when the target is a packet start of the same function; the rest of the packet is re-parsed as an independent packet without control flow (as the delay slot of the prefix forms)

context_rules.name: slot_S0_R7_m1
context_rules.rule: forms ldslot_S0_m1 / stslot_S0_m1 — the R7 rule also for the slot family with m = 1 (k >= 32) but only with op 4/8/c (low nibble 4/8/c: k mod 4 != 0) and when no other instruction of the packet has a ? mnemonic (ctx rest_named_no_q); the op 0 sub-family (ldslot shape with o3 = 0 and m = 1) stays .hword (ld heads with a high-bank base)

context_rules.name: b111_layout
context_rules.rule: constraint ctx b111_layout of the group-b111 context forms: the type-111 pair (ld.bu, or st.b whose tail is also a named 16-bit op) is admitted only (a) in a packet (or delay-slot sub-packet) of exactly two units with the head at unit 0 and the adjacent closing tail, or (b) as one of the two pairs of the H H T T / H H T T C layout (heads op 0/1 at units 0 and 1 with their tails at 2 and 3); never when the tail is an O syllable (bits 13:11 = 111) and an op 7 head (bit 15 = 0) precedes the tail in the packet

context_rules.name: hhtt_second_head
context_rules.rule: constraint ctx hhtt_second_head of the forms hhttF0_*: an op 0 head (bit 15 = 0) at unit i whose tail is the unit i + 2 with F' = 0 and tt = 01/10, when the instruction decoded before it is a head of op 0/1 (bit 15 = 0) at unit i - 1 with the single tail i + 1 and kind ld/st (the H H T T layout with a named first pair); evaluated inside the layout score (the reading is named: s0 drops by 2)

context_rules.name: f0d_triple
context_rules.rule: constraint ctx f0d_triple of the forms rf0d_*: head op 0 with F = 1, m = 0, rA = r14 (0101 110x BBBB 0000) at unit i, the unit i + 1 has bits 15:14 = 01 (a head shape), the tail is the unit i + 2 with F' = 0 and tt = 01/10 (S free), and the pair (head, adjacent unit) would otherwise be read ld.w F != S or .word; B = sp with x = 0 excluded; evaluated inside the layout score

context_rules.name: f0d_middle_unit
context_rules.rule: the unit between an rf0d_* head and its deferred tail, when it was decoded as a 16-bit op without tail, is re-read with the FIRST-SLOT 16-bit cell and keeps that reading only when it is named (not .hword / fmt), its kind is not control (br/br16/br16d/call/call16/calla/jumpa/ret/callr/jr/loop) and its first operand is not r14 (addi r14, #odd is impossible); otherwise the tail-position reading stays (the h = 1 cell is open)

context_rules.name: bfpair
context_rules.rule: constraint ctx bfpair of the forms bfpair_* (group hhtt): the packet has exactly 4 units, units 0 and 1 are op 7 heads (bit 15 = 0, low nibble 7), unit 2 is a tail with S = 0 and tt = 01, unit 3 a tail with S = 1 and tt = 01, both cells valid (c != 3, 1 <= w, w + pos <= 32), and the reading pairs 0 -> 2 and 1 -> 3; then both pairs are named by the general formula (w = a, pos = rotr5(b)) whatever the cell

context_rules.name: bf_dst_not_written
context_rules.rule: constraint ctx bf_dst_not_written of the post-layout renames bfsel_*: no OTHER instruction of the packet whose kind is one of the WAW kinds (alu/alu32/mov/movi/movi21/ld/dsp/mul/mov32/movi32/mem16/bit/dspacc/csr/io; stores excluded) has rB(!x) (the destination of the .bf? pair, printed r<n> or r<n>!) as its first operand; otherwise the cell stays .bf?

context_rules.name: between_dsp_head_and_tail
context_rules.rule: constraint ctx between_dsp_head_and_tail of the post-layout rename hword_0Xff_dsp: the unit is at index 1 of the packet, the first decoded instruction of the packet is a head of op 7 or op c with bit 15 = 0 and at least two units, and its last unit lies after this unit (the 0Xff unit sits between the DSP head and its tail): the movi rA, #-1 reading reverts to .hword

context_rules.name: rest_named_no_q
context_rules.rule: (R-slotm1): constraint ctx rest_named_no_q of ldslot_S0_m1 / stslot_S0_m1: every other instruction of the packet is named and none of their mnemonics ends with ?

context_rules.name: hi_lo_fam_before
context_rules.rule: H1 (replaces lo_after_hi): a bare unit with bits 12:9 = 1010 and bit 15 = 0 is .hi (form hi1010_loose, context) only when a head of the 48-bit family [0][F][01][A][B][op 0/4/5/6/7] (not itself hi-shaped, not ret/save/restore) precedes it in the packet (fam_before); a .hword unit after such a hi-shaped unit with fam_before is .lo unless the previous instruction is named; otherwise hi-shaped units are ordinary 16-bit heads (rA = r10)

context_rules.name: nop_ctl
context_rules.rule: after the layout, a 5e0d / 1e0d / de0d unit whose reading is unnamed (.ctl15 / .hword) is nop.ctl (form nop_ctl, rename_from); never a head with a tail nor a tail (R-ctl15)

context_rules.name: cop_addi32
context_rules.rule: after the layout, in a packet containing `cop rA` (forms cop / cop_FS0), a unit [1][1][0][0][rA][1][0000][0011] (same rrr) read as ld.h / unnamed is addi rA, #32 (form addi32_cop, constraint ctx cop_rA_in_packet)

context_rules.name: renames_post_layout
context_rules.mnemonic: lsl / lsl? / sext16 / zext16 / ld.w? / ld.h? / ld.hu? / .ldF0? / bset / bext / .3eX0?
context_rules.rule: see structure.packet.renames_post_layout and the forms with rename_only (groups rename16 / rename32 / rename48 + ld_w16_A_k0 / nop_ctl / addi32_cop)

context_rules.name: ext_after_ldst
context_rules.rule: a final unit [1][1][1][1][rrr][0][B][0111] (16-bit movi r8-15) two units after a ld/st whose single tail has S = 0 is an extension unit of that access, not a movi

context_rules.name: be79_prefix
context_rules.rule: a bare head [0][0][imm14] without a named reading followed by be79 (nop) = .be79 #imm14: DTCM address prefix, operation open

context_rules.name: bz_s_P4
context_rules.rule: see form bz_s_P4: [0][1][0][h][rrr][x][B][1101] opening a 2-unit packet without a named pairing = bz.s rA, pc + 2*d6; rA = r14 excluded (5cXd = call.s when the target is a function start, form call_s_S0)

context_rules.name: slot_S0_R7
context_rules.rule: rule R7: forms ldslot_S0/stslot_S0 — a bare first-slot unit with bit 15 = 0 of the slot family [0][1][0][h][rrr][x][B][o3 o2 00], read as .hword, in a packet whose every other instruction is named, is ldslot/stslot rB(!x), #k (k = h:rrr:o3); the score counts it as named (unnamed - 1) so that it beats .op8?/.word readings but not a named pair

context_rules.name: lea_sp_S0
context_rules.rule: form lea_sp_S0 — a bare first-slot unit with bit 15 = 0 of the shape [0][0][0][h][rrr][x][B][o 000] with rA != r14, read as .hword, in a packet whose every other instruction is a named 16-bit op WITHOUT tail, is lea? rA, [sp + 4*(x:B:o3)]; same score credit as R7

context_rules.name: op8_slot_split
context_rules.rule: a pair read .op8? / .op8.t? whose tail is ADJACENT and whose two units are both slot-family units ([S][F][m][h][rrr][x][B][o3 o2 00] with the low 12 bits != 0, not addsp-shaped (F = 0, h = 1, rrr = 6)), except when the first is a ld/st head shape (bit 15 = 0, o3 = 0) and the second a ld/st tail shape (F' = 1, tt != 11) or both are loads (o2 = 0) of the same register (x:B), is split into TWO 16-bit ops ldslot/stslot r(x:B), #k (context forms ldslot_split / stslot_split; the split changes the score: 0 unknown units, +1 instruction)

context_rules.name: sgt_closer_pair
context_rules.rule: the 16-bit movi head 4NN7 (op 7, F=1, ss=0, x=0) followed by the closer cc00 is the pair sgt rN, rN, #0

context_rules.name: cells_by_position
context_rules.rule: see structure.packet.grammar_rules["cells by position"]: forms ld_w16_A_k0, mfacc_q_C_k2, cellE_* with the constraints head_index / head_pos_ge / packet_len_ge

context_rules.name: not_ext_of_op67
context_rules.rule: constraint ctx not_ext_of_op67: the op 0 F = S = 1 + [1][1][00][f12 = 1 mod 4] relabel to add does not apply to a head at unit index 1 whose low byte is 0 (x = 0, B = 0) when unit 0 has bit 15 = 0, F = 0 and op in {6, 7} (extension word of that head)

constraint_ops.instr_index: (S0-slot): the INSTRUCTION position of the unit inside the decoded packet (0 = first instruction; not the unit index) must be == n; evaluated after the layout (structure.packet.post_layout_splits)
constraint_ops.gt: greater than (low12 > 1 of the slot forms)
constraint_ops.ctx: /14/15: a named context condition that needs the other units of the packet: not_ext_of_op67, cop_rA_in_packet, not_c48_lo_follows, b111_layout, hhtt_second_head, f0d_triple, bfpair, bf_dst_not_written, between_dsp_head_and_tail, rest_named_no_q (see context_rules)
constraint_ops.fuse_pair: (op72_q): per-form key fuse_pair = true: a post-layout FUSION of two adjacent one-unit instructions (rename_from = [head reading, tail reading]) into one two-unit instruction (structure.packet.post_layout_fusion)
constraint_ops.split_role: (group lownib): per-form key split_role = 'either' / 'bare': the form is applied by the post-layout split procedure (structure.packet.post_layout_splits) to the head or the tail of an undone pair ('either') or to a bare .hword unit ('bare'); rename_from lists the pair readings it may replace ('@split_tail' = the re-read tail of a split)
constraint_ops.tail_adjacent in any: (beq9sp): any(rA != 14, m == 1, tail_adjacent == false) on beq_imm8_d: evaluated with the layout (deferred); failure = fall through
constraint_ops.eq/ne/lt/ge/in/notin/range/ranges/even/o: on a decoded field value (range = [lo, hi)); ge = greater or equal; odd
constraint_ops.packet_len: packet must have exactly n units (n = 1: stand-alone unit; n = 3: add32_0eX0_L1; unknown packet length -> the constraint fails, so the stand-alone forms never count as "named 16-bit ops" for the pairing predicates)
constraint_ops.packet_len_ge: the packet must have at least n units (ld_w16_A_k0: multi-unit packet)
constraint_ops.tail_adjacent: (R-ldF0 renames): true = the (single) tail is the unit right after the head; false = it is farther; evaluated with the layout (post-layout renames only)
constraint_ops.ieee_short: (R-movhi10, movhi_tt10_short): the 32-bit value v is the high word of an IEEE-754 double d = unpack(v << 32) with 1e-9 <= |d| <= 1e12 that round-trips through n significant decimal digits (n = 3: "%.2e")
constraint_ops.ctx cop_rA_in_packet: (addi32_cop): some instruction of the packet is cop rA with the same rrr
constraint_ops.ctx not_c48_lo_follows: (x1e0_* renames): the tail is not 5ffd followed (next unit of the packet) by bfff / ffff (the mov32 #0x7fff7fff of R-c48tab)
constraint_ops.rename_from: list of the readings (mnemonics or @kind) a post-layout rename form may replace (structure.packet.renames_post_layout)
constraint_ops.field in C48_TABLE (val): (c48tab_*): the 32-bit value is one of the 16 table constants; for the head:hi partial match of the parser, some table value must have the same upper 18 bits
constraint_ops.head_index / head_pos_ge: the unit index k of the head inside the packet (0 = first unit) must be == n / >= n (cells by position: ld_w16_A_k0 k = 0, cellE_st_h_q_k1 k = 1, cellE_add_q_k2 and mfacc_q_C_k2 k >= 2); unknown k -> the constraint fails
constraint_ops.tail_adjacency 2 (ld/st): (R-op1fs): for the ld/st forms mem_ld_b_t4_F1S0 / mem_st_h_t6_F1S0 the tail must be EXACTLY at +2; at any other distance the pair is undone into two 16-bit ops (not .word)
constraint_ops.br0_cells: list of [B-class, tail distance] pairs; holds when [class of the head field B (B0 = 0, B15 = 15, B = other), distance head -> tail in units (1 or 2)] is in the list; evaluated with the layout (deferred: an unknown distance accepts)
constraint_ops.br0_cells_live: (R-br0): as br0_cells but only at the origins of a live trace, which are not part of this table; for the plugin the constraint never holds (the five weak cells are omitted)
constraint_ops.bf_valid: (R-bfpair, forms bfpair_*): the bit-field cell is valid: 1 <= w and w + pos <= 32 (w = tail bits 9:5, pos = rotr5(tail bits 4:0)); c = 3 is excluded by the pattern
constraint_ops.guard target_packet_start_any_or_functio: (R-tgt, b_near): the pc-relative target must be a packet start of ANY function of the image (the exception vectors jump to the veneer of another function) or a function start; failure = .word
constraint_ops.guard_failure: per-form key guard_failure = 'fallthrough': a failing TARGET guard does not make the pair .word but tries the next form of the cell (and, when none is left, the two units are 16-bit ops); absent = 'word'
constraint_ops.any with guard / packet_len: (bz_s_P5): any([packet_len == 2, guard target_packet_start_same_function]): the target guard is evaluated with the pc for 16-bit context forms (the decoder applies the rule explicitly in parse_packet)
constraint_ops.guard head_not_validated_bs: (R-st1h): in the FIRST slot the form does not match when the head is a b.s shape [0][1][m][1][110][x][B][0001] (not m = 0 with d6 = 0) whose target pc + 2*sext7(D:d6) is a packet start of the same function (the 16-bit b.s wins); evaluated after the mask match like the target guards, but a failure UNDOES the pair into two 16-bit ops (not .word)
constraint_ops.packet_prefix: forms with packet_prefix = true (bcc48/bcc64) are matched only as a packet prefix (see structure.packet.prefix_forms): guard failure = form not taken (no .word, no fall-through to another prefix form of the same cell except the ordered table)
constraint_ops.tail_adjacency defer: (R-st1h): the tail must be at +2 or farther; an adjacent tail undoes the pair into two 16-bit ops
constraint_ops.guard setcc_tail: tail unit not a named 16-bit op unless f12 in small
constraint_ops.guard tail_not_named16: tail unit not a named 16-bit op (setcc, or.2, add.1, st_w_op1_F1S0, st_b_q, mtcsr_q)
constraint_ops.guard or2_tail: if the tail is not a named 16-bit op: u12 one-bit mask or < 0x100; else u12 one-bit mask and the head not a named 16-bit op
constraint_ops.guard target_packet_start_same_function: the pc-relative target must be a packet start inside the same function (loop_F0, loop_imm_*, bcc_F0, beqz_d/bnez_d, and the bcc48/bcc64 prefix forms; needs the packet model / function table)
constraint_ops.guard target_function_start: the pc-relative target must be a function start (call_F0, call_s_S0; needs the function table)
constraint_ops.target_guard_semantics: for 32-bit forms the target guards are evaluated AFTER the mask match: a matching pair whose guard fails is .word (2 unnamed units), it does not fall through to the next form; for 16-bit forms (call_s_S0) a failing guard falls through to the next form
constraint_ops.closer: a 16-bit form whose mask includes bit 15 = 1 matches only a unit that closes the packet; the ordinary 16-bit forms mask bit 15 out

forms.name: ret
forms.semantics: return (pc = r15)
forms.packet_rules: stand-alone unit; never takes a tail

forms.name: ret_d
forms.semantics: return; the rest of the packet is the delay slot
forms.packet_rules: head without tail (bit 15 = 0): delay slot = rest of packet (S7)

forms.name: ret_s
forms.semantics: return with synchronisation after CSR writes
forms.packet_rules: stand-alone

forms.name: ret_s_d

forms.name: c48tab_mov32

fields.name: x
fields.notes: head bit 8: high-bank flag

forms.semantics: rB(!x) = imm32 for the 16 values of the 48-bit value table (imm32 = head[13:9] << 27 | hi[12:0] << 14 | lo[13:0]; any op 0 head with bit 15 = 0, hi with bit 15 = 0, L = hi bit 13)
forms.packet_rules: slot of the head free; hi/lo by round-robin (the head class admits the pair when head:hi:lo complete a table value: partial match on head:hi against the upper 18 bits); matched before every other 48-bit op 0 form

forms.packet_rules: slot of the head free; hi/lo by round-robin (the head class admits the pair when head:hi:lo complete a table value: partial match on head:hi against the upper 18 bits); matched before every other 48-bit op 0 form
